description: List connected X (Twitter) accounts. Search by username or filter by site. Each account record includes premium (boolean) and max_tweet_length (integer) — ALWAYS read these before drafting tweet content. Premium accounts allow up to 25,000 chars; non-premium are limited to 280. If max_tweet_length is null, treat the limit as unknown and ask the user rather than assuming 280.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

username.description: Filter accounts by text in the username, display name, account id or site. Case-insensitive. Applies when domain and site_id are omitted.

name: get_x_accounts
title: Get X Accounts
